name: IKS Penance
_comment: R3.37, Module R3 SSD book page 4. Corner reads YS:172 DK:6 EX:17 CR:5; the annex agrees on
POINT VALUE 114/95 is the economic/combat split of R3.R51 — the lower combat rating applies
because this hull declares a poor crew. The sheet's 'LIMITED AEGIS SYSTEM CONTROLS PH-3s AND
ADDs' is exactly what our D5 already carries.
Entered from the D5, which turned out to be the right sibling despite being a later ship: the
D5J's sheet shows the same phaser-1s forward, phaser-3s on the wings, four range-30
disruptors, two type-A racks, two ADDs and DERFACS. THREE things differ, not the usual two:
- centerWarp 2, the penal boom (R3.R53). WRP-C / IMP / WRP-C, as on the D6J.
- security 4 rather than 2 — two boxes in the boom, two in the hull.
- auxCon 1, where the D5 has 2. Read off the sheet at 600 dpi rather than assumed, and the
only reason it was checked is that a 300 dpi crop had clipped the box.
Shield 2 was counted box by box as 26 (10 + 10 + 6), which matches the D5 and confirms a penal
conversion leaves shields alone, as the F5/F5J pair already showed.
No B refit: the ship data table lists only the Y175 refit, and says outright that the UIM
refit is not available. No K phaser refit either — the phaser-1s are already fitted.
_y175Comment: The sheet: 'SHIP HAD TYPE-A DRONE RACKS (ONE RELOAD) UNTIL THE Y175 REFIT, WHICH CONVERTED
THESE TO TYPE-B DRONE RACKS (2 RELOADS).' One reload becomes two, hence extraReloads 1 —
the same shape d5c.json already uses.
